paragraphs.title: The Vision of the Almond Branch

answers: A rod of an almond tree
easy.explanation: Jeremiah said, “I see a rod of an almond tree.”
easy.q: What did Jeremiah see in the first vision?

easy.explanation: The Lord asked Jeremiah, “What seest thou?”
easy.q: Who asked Jeremiah what he saw?

easy.explanation: The Lord said, “Thou hast well seen.”
easy.q: How did the Lord respond to Jeremiah's answer?

answers: The Lord's hastening to perform His word
medium.explanation: The Lord said, “I will hasten my word to perform it.”
medium.q: What did the vision of the almond branch represent?

answers: Act quickly and diligently to fulfill it
medium.explanation: The word indicates readiness and speed in carrying out the Lord's word.
medium.q: What does “hasten” mean in “I will hasten my word to perform it”?

answers: The vision shows that the Lord's word will be forgotten
The vision shows that the Lord's word will be fulfilled
The vision shows that Jeremiah would not hear the Lord
medium.explanation: The Lord explains that He will hasten His word to perform it.
medium.q: What is the connection between the vision and the word of the Lord?

answers: Because it points to the Lord's watchfulness and speed in fulfilling His word
Because the branch was a weapon of war
Because it represented the kingdom of Judah
challenge.explanation: The vision connects the almond branch with the Lord's readiness to perform His word.
challenge.q: Why was an almond branch suitable as a symbol in this passage?

answers: Jeremiah correctly recognized what he was shown
Jeremiah saw a pot instead of a branch
challenge.explanation: The Lord confirmed that Jeremiah had identified the object correctly before explaining its meaning.
challenge.q: What can be inferred from the Lord saying, “Thou hast well seen”?

answers: The Lord watches over His word to fulfill it
challenge.explanation: The Lord explicitly says that He will hasten His word to perform it.
challenge.q: Which central idea appears in the vision of the almond branch?

answers: A rod of an almond tree

easy.explanation: The Lord said, “Out of the north an evil shall break forth.”

answers: Upon all the inhabitants of the land
Only upon the people of Anathoth

easy.q: Upon whom would the evil come?

answers: Evil and disaster from the north
medium.explanation: The Lord explains that evil would break forth out of the north.
medium.q: What did the pot facing north represent?

medium.explanation: “Seething” describes a pot boiling or bubbling, fitting the threatening vision.
medium.q: What does “seething” mean in “a seething pot”?

Jeremiah's deliverance leads to the building of the temple
